action_description: one continuous fast 3-hit sword combo with no pause between the hits, seen from the side facing right: (1) he steps forward and slashes horizontally from back to front, the blade ending low in front; (2) straight from there he sweeps the sword upward in a rising diagonal cut, the blade ending high above his head; (3) straight from there he hops forward and chops down hard in front of him, the blade stopping near the ground, then he returns to his ready stance. Each swing is quick with a short wind-up and a clear follow-through, the end of one swing is the start of the next. The red scarf-cape and hair whip behind the motion. A bright white-blue slash arc follows the blade on each swing. Keep the same side-on angle facing right in every frame, do not turn toward the camera, same size, no smoke, no dust clouds.
